outcome: Regional cerebral fractional tissue oxygen extraction (cFTOE)
cohort: The study included 44 healthy term newborns delivered by primary cesarean section who did not require any medical support during the 15 minutes after cord clamping.
finding: The study established reference ranges for crSO2 and cFTOE measured with the Masimo O3 oximeter during immediate neonatal transition, finding that O3 values were significantly higher than those obtained with the NIRO-200NX device.
